title: Lens: Core Loop
summary: Scan unknowns, read the result, act once, and rescan after the world changes.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Find an unknown target, scan it, read the result, open related Wiki or Index records, then decide whether to harvest, power, repair, or avoid it.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each scan, name the decision it supports: harvest, avoid, repair, power, route, or investigate. If the scan does not change behavior, save it for later.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop scanning when the area is already understood. Move on, mark the result, or return with a tool that can use the information.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
